label.purpose: Eyebrows, badges and all tabular values.

shadows.name: panel-seat

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary action and live traveller only.

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: Primary GO action: dispatch, enter, confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-signal { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 20px; font: 600 12px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.88 0.2 108 / 45%), 0 0 28px -8px oklch(0.88 0.2 108 / 60%); transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-signal:hover { background: oklch(0.83 0.2 108); } .ds-btn-signal:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-signal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action that never commits anything.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-input); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/1 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: oklch(0.88 0.2 108 / 60%); background: oklch(0.28 0.035 195 / 40%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Telemetry Strip
components.description: Persistent live status and counters above the console.
components.css: .ds-telemetry { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: oklch(0.145 0.014 258 / 92%); font: 500 12px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-success); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--color-success); } .ds-state { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; color: var(--color-foreground); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Instrument Bay
components.description: The standard surface for every panel and result.
components.css: .ds-bay { position: relative; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-top-color: var(--color-panel-edge); border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(155deg, oklch(0.205 0.018 258), oklch(0.165 0.013 258)); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 5%) inset, 0 18px 40px -24px oklch(0 0 0 / 85%); color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-bay::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 6px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-left: 1px solid var(--color-primary); opacity: 0.55; } .ds-bay::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-primary); opacity: 0.55; } .ds-bay-label { margin: 0 0 20px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); font: 500 11px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Mono status label; colour carries the semantic state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 11px/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-badge-pending { border-color: oklch(0.83 0.16 68 / 40%); background: oklch(0.83 0.16 68 / 10%); color: var(--color-warning); }

components.name: Routing Node
components.description: Checkpoint in the live routing diagram.
components.css: .ds-node { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 56px; font: 600 12px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-node > span.ds-node-label { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--color-foreground); text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-node::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-secondary); }

narrative.overview: CentralIA looks like the instrument panel of a machine that is already running. The operator does not read a report about automation; they watch work move. A request enters on the left, crosses three closed checkpoints, and leaves as an audited execution — the motion is the argument. Density is high but never noisy: every surface is a labelled bay, every number is a monospaced readout, and the only bright colour on the screen means "this is moving" or "this needs you". The palette refuses the generic neon-on-black dashboard by giving colour a job instead of a mood. Lime is the GO signal, amber is a person being asked, coral is a refusal, sky is information. Everything else is cold graphite with fine technical grids.
keyCharacteristics: Instrument bays with corner ticks instead of soft cards.
Small radii, hairline borders, tonal depth.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Go Lime never decorates. It marks motion, the primary action, or a live value — nothing else gets it.

rules.name: The Status-is-Colour Rule
rules.body: Amber, coral, green and sky are reserved vocabulary. Never borrow one for emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Every number, timestamp, status and code-like value uses IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures. If it can be compared, it must align.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No card floats at rest. Glow belongs to the GO state, not to decoration.

dos: Do lead with what is running
Do label every figure in mono
donts: Don't invent zeros or percentages to fill a bay
Don't round panels like consumer cards
Don't add a second decorative animation when the telemetry already moves
